title: Super rug!
text: Super rug!. I bought this rug for my deck and really like the denim blue color.  Although like most outdoor rugs it isn't incredibly soft, it will be easily rinsed off with a hose and adds a little something extra to an otherwise dreary space.

product_metadata.title: Novogratz by Momeni Villa Collection Tuscany Indoor Outdoor Blue Area Rug, 3'11" x 5' Sized Mat for Pool, Patio, Porch, Balcony, Kitchen, Bedroom, Livingroom and Home Office
features: QUALITY MATERIALS: Polypropylene. Expertly Woven for lasting quality and easy care.
HIGH-QUALITY FINISH: The power loomed outdoor rug is a classic design made of 100% washable polypropylene. The intricate details and bright colors are perfect to complement any outdoor setting.

UNPARALLELED DESIGN: With intricate designs and comfortable fabric, the Villa blue area rug collection is a versatile addition to any décor. The geometric pattern of this particular rug will make a statement in any space whether it is the patio, pool area, living room, bedroom or home office.
EASY CARE FOR: To keep this navy rug in mint condition, spot clean with water and mild soap as needed. Do not machine wash or dry. This waterproof rug can be used indoors or outdoors.

LOW PROFILE PILE: The 0.1'' low-profile pile of this navy rug gives any area a stylish decor without being overly bulky or cumbersome. This blue rug is perfect for any high or low traffic area. Its weather-resistant construction also makes the Villa rug perfect for the porch, pool area, or patio.
JUTE BACKING: Natural jute backing is safe for all floors and provides an extra layer of cushioning to help reduce wear and tear.

NOVOGRATZ STYLE: This is a piece that will never go out of style, and it seamlessly combines traditional elements with contemporary ones. The bold navy colors and the abstract geometric designs of this Villa rug will add a unique modern decor to any space in your home, whether indoor or outdoor.

DURABLE CONSTRUCTION: This outdoor carpet is expertly crafted with a power-loomed construction of durable polypropylene fibers. The 3'11"x5' sized rug is perfect for an entryway, bathroom, mudroom, porch, or as an outdoor balcony rug.
